messages:
Raj Patel: Passing EdgeBridge (mid-market fintech) to CS - closed yesterday. Quick context: they need a Private deployment (VPC) + Okta SSO, plan to use Dedicated capacity with monthly commit. Primary contacts: Maria Ortiz (Product), Daniel Wu (Infra). Expected traffic: 50-100 QPS peak, typical seq len 256. SLA asks: 99th < 300ms. Renewal ~11 months. Legal flagged data residency and will request SOC2 + DPA. Open asks: CSM assignment, engineering ticket for VPC peering & cert exchange, enablement for their SOC/compliance team. Risk: if pilot slips beyond 3 weeks renewal touchpoint might get cold.

Amanda Li: Hi - I can own CSM for EdgeBridge. Thanks for the handoff, Raj. Can you confirm kickoff window? Also need Maria's calendar & Okta admin contact. I'll draft the onboarding runbook and send invites.

Raj Patel: Thanks Amanda - Maria: maria.ortiz@edgebridge.com, Okta admin: dwu@edgebridge.com (same Daniel). Pilot target: start in 2 weeks. Billing is committed monthly (sales handled). Legal paperwork pending but already routed.

Leo Kim: Eng notes: we'll need VPC peering IP ranges, egress requirements, and the Okta metadata file (SP/IDP). Also need to know whether they plan to use model pinning or allow automatic routing to cheaper variant. If they want specific quantized model we'll need build window (3-5 days). Tagging @Maya for support runbook.

Maya Gomez: Support: I'll own runbook + post-prod playbook. Items to capture: escalation path, log access (who from EdgeBridge), expected error modes, fallback model policy, and retention policy for prompts. Suggest we add a "pilot incident" drill in week 2 after pilot starts.

Katie Chen: Heads up - renewal risk medium if we don't show value quickly. Recommend weekly exec sync between Amanda and Maria for first 6 weeks and a success metrics deck (latency, cost savings, accuracy) for the C-suite. Also need enablement packs for their infra and compliance teams.

OnboardBot: CHECKLIST CREATED - Kickoff slot requested (wk of 1764510140), Okta metadata file requested, VPC peering form submitted, Dedicated capacity reservation pending, SOC2 artifact request logged. Link: https://internal.redwood/edgebridge/onboarding

Raj Patel: noted. I updated the sales CRM with Amanda as primary CSM and attached contract and SOC2 note. Thanks all.

Amanda Li: Summarizing owners & next steps:
- Amanda Li: schedule kickoff, onboarding runbook + weekly exec sync
- Leo Kim: create eng ticket for VPC peering, Okta metadata ingestion, model pin/build estimate
- Maya Gomez: build support runbook + pilot incident drill
- Katie Chen: prepare success metrics deck & enablement materials
- Raj Patel: confirm legal timeline and hand over SOC2 artifacts
I'll create a shared doc and chase blocked items. :thumbsup:
